Asset type: ONE standalone portrait 2:3, 1024x1536 illustrated Chinese seasonal greeting card; one complete image, not a collage.

Primary request: 白露, the 丝线刺绣 series.
Scene and seasonal subjects: a white egret standing among autumn reeds and long grass with clear dew drops; serene early autumn morning.
Style and composition: Match the reference's delicate Chinese silk embroidery on woven ivory linen: visible directional satin stitches, fine threads, subtle raised texture, luminous silk highlights and calm negative space. Use a restrained seasonal palette and place the motif below the title.
